note: How to run: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\shoot-own.ps1 -Name surfaces -Script scripts\visual\perf-window.json -Fresh -TimeoutSec 420 . It turns on the measuring hooks (lib/perf.ts) and reloads, builds a chat with 3,000 rows of history on the lead, measures idle, typing, scrolling, then starts Go crazy in Ultra (about 30 agents, several writing at once) and measures typing, scrolling and long tasks while they stream. Each [script] line is one measurement as JSON. typing: frameMedian/frameWorst = ms from inserting a character in the message box to the next drawn frame (includes waiting for that frame); handler = ms spent handling the key. scroll: one step of 150 px per frame through everything the transcript lets you reach, top and back; over16 = frames longer than 17.5 ms, over50 = longer than 50 ms. window: commits per second (React), renders per second of each counted part, long tasks (>50 ms), running animations, DOM nodes, JS heap. The window is the hidden off-screen demo window: software drawing at 60 frames a second, so absolute numbers are a worst case next to a real GPU; compare before and after on the same machine.

js: const btn = (re) => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => re.test((b.textContent || '').trim()) && !b.disabled); const sl = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); btn(/^Continue/)?.click(); await sl(2500); btn(/^Start with an empty chat/)?.click(); await sl(2500); localStorage.setItem('ensemble-perf', '1'); setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 50); return 'first run done, accounts ' + window.__ensemble.getState().accounts.length + '; reloading with the measuring hooks';

window.__P.img = "C:\\Users\\kerim\\ensemble\\scripts\\visual\\sample-image.png"; const S = window.__P.S; S().newChat(); await window.__P.sleep(400); await S().send('Say hello in one line.'); await window.__P.sleep(200); const t = Date.now(); while (Date.now() - t < 30000 && (window.__P.working() || !(S().items[window.__P.key()] || []).some(i => i.kind === 'turn'))) await window.__P.sleep(300); return 'chat ' + S().chatId + ' lead ' + window.__P.lead() + ' accounts ' + S().accounts.length;

const n = window.__P.inject(3000); await window.__P.sleep(2500); return JSON.stringify({ injected: n, rows: window.__P.S().items[window.__P.key()].length, dom: window.__P.dom(), heapMB: window.__P.heap() });

const el = window.__P.scroller(); el.scrollTop = Math.round(el.scrollHeight * 0.45); await new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(r))); const v = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const rows = [...el.querySelectorAll('[data-b]')].filter(r => { const b = r.getBoundingClientRect(); return b.bottom > v.top && b.top < v.bottom; }); const covered = rows.reduce((s, r) => { const b = r.getBoundingClientRect(); return s + Math.max(0, Math.min(b.bottom, v.bottom) - Math.max(b.top, v.top)); }, 0); return 'jump to the middle: rows in view ' + rows.length + ', view covered by rows ' + Math.round(100 * covered / v.height) + '% (the rest is the gaps between rows)';
return 'scroll control (static copy, no app work) ' + JSON.stringify(await window.__P.control(150, 2000));

const S = window.__P.S; await window.ensemble.setUltra(S().chatId, true); await window.__P.sleep(300); await S().send('/gocrazy design the landing page'); const t = Date.now(); while (Date.now() - t < 20000 && window.__P.working() < 6) await window.__P.sleep(200); return 'streaming started: ' + window.__P.working() + ' working after ' + (Date.now() - t) + ' ms';

const t = Date.now(); while (Date.now() - t < 120000 && window.__P.working()) await window.__P.sleep(500); await window.__P.sleep(3000); return 'run ended after ' + Math.round((Date.now() - t) / 1000) + ' s; idle again ' + JSON.stringify(await window.__P.window(8000));

return 'long tasks total ' + window.__P.long.length + ' | rows ' + window.__P.S().items[window.__P.key()].length + ' | agents in chat ' + (window.__P.S().chats.find(c => c.id === window.__P.S().chatId)?.agents || []).length;
